extracted.name: Baked Scalloped Potatoes
extracted.description: These baked scalloped potatoes with mushroom soup make a cozy, comforting side dish that goes well with any entrée. It’s such an easy 5-ingredient recipe!
ingredient_lines: 1 (10.5 ounce) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1.25 cups milk, or more as needed
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Grease a 2-quart casserole dish.
Whisk condensed soup, milk, and pepper together in a bowl.
Layer potatoes and onion in the prepared casserole dish. Pour soup mixture over top; it should almost cover potatoes and onion. If it doesn’t, add more milk.
Cover and bake in the preheated 375 degrees F (190 degrees C) oven until potatoes are tender, about 1 hour, stirring halfway through.
